answer: Admission auction: agents bid a deposit for slots, and only the top K bids win entry. A sybil attacker wanting 100 fake identities must outbid honest agents 100 times — at a 20 POA minimum, 2,000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays once. Deposits thaw like a glacier over 20 epochs, so a fake identity cannot cash out fast. The honest reward is the nectar — fees from real work — while the opal, the scarce slot, goes to the highest bidder.
